interaction.prompt: An opponent has the puck in your corner. Drag your goalie and your defenseman to the spots that best protect your net.

feedback.right: Goalie square in the crease, defenseman in the slot. Now the most dangerous ice in front of the net is covered.
feedback.wrong: The net front and the slot are where goals come from. Keep your goalie in the crease and your defenseman in the slot, not chasing the puck to the corner.

tip: Protect the middle first. The slot and the crease are where most goals are scored.
why: Young defenders chase the puck into the corner and leave the net open. Holding the slot and the crease takes away the highest-danger ice.
